= Image attribute insertion
:name: Early
:literal: \{name}
:alias: {literal}
:slots: "{alias}",80,40
:empty: pass:[]

:name: Late

image::unquoted.png[{alias}]

image::double.png["{alias}"]

image::single.png['{alias}']

image::named.png[alt="{alias}"]

image::expanded-slots.png[{slots}]

image::empty.png["{empty}"]

image::literal.png["*{alias}* & <tag>"]
